Plotter gen

Generators for pen plotting on a Cricut Explore 5: every page makes millimetre-exact SVGs, one file per pen. Some of them hide messages, and the decoder reads them back off paper.

Read

Plot decoderPoint a phone camera at a plot (or upload a photo) and read the hidden message back.

Hide

Purloined plot studioUnravel the Purloined's knitting encoders as plots: dot charts, stitches, cross-stitch, punch cards, Truchet. Cipher gardenDrawings that are the code: Truchet tiles, mazes, a Hilbert thread, ridgelines, pigpen, constellations, cipher disks, automata, knots. Overlay studioTwo sheets, a slide or a cut: visual cryptography, moire reveals and turning grilles.

Signal

Signal bookAlphabets as pictures: ship's signal flags on hoists, semaphore, ogham, braille shapes and tap code.

Gears

Gear 3D studio3D gears under a perspective lens on floors of rays, rings, ripples and Truchet ribbons. Gear BAM studioComic 3D gears with crosshatched walls, riso halftone tops and extruded sound effects. Gear weave studioHundreds of overlapping gears woven over and under like chainmail. Gear reverb studioA meshing gear train wrapped in reverb rings, tilted under a camera.
Made in the PLOTTER_GEN workshop. Hidden-message encoders come from Unravel the Purloined. Classical ciphers are historical puzzles, not modern security.
